quotations.registered_grid: The color and depth images are already pre-registered using the OpenNI driver from PrimeSense, i.e., the pixels in the color and depth images correspond already 1:1.
quotations.recommendation: We recommend to use the ROS default parameter set (i.e., without undistortion), as undistortion of the pre-registered depth images is not trivial.
quotations.scale_applied: We already pre-scaled the depth images of all sequences accordingly, so that no action on your side is necessary.

limitations: The official page calls these default intrinsics uncalibrated; this is a documented registered-grid baseline, not independently measured camera calibration.
OpenNI registration and native infrared/RGB extrinsics are not independently reconstructed.
Published source RGB K/D are provenance and do not justify an additional Brown correction of registered depth.
No evidence yet establishes reduced trajectory drift; recordings are already viewed.
No vehicle extrinsics, driving integration or calibrated covariance.
